links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses on pulpotomy for patients and parents (FKRGL, FRES)
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 responses were more complex, requiring university-level reading skills (FKRGL); Gemini Pro's responses were more readable.
links.quote: Gemini Pro demonstrated higher reliability and quality scores (DISCERN and EQIP), while ChatGPT-4 produced responses with higher complexity, requiring university-level reading skills (FKRGL).

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the quality, reliability, and readability of responses from ChatGPT-4.0 and Google Gemini Pro to patient/parent questions regarding pediatric dental pulpotomy without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
